sources: https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/models (OpenAI Codex models and plans, read 2026-11-11)
Codex CLI 0.167.1 signed in with a ChatGPT Free account (codex exec per model and the /model picker, tested 2026-11-12)
skills/dual-model-review/SKILL.md as of 2026-10 (vendor system cards, API price lists, third-party effort sweeps; not re-checked on 2026-11-11)

models.gpt-6-astra: Most capable model for complex work across code, apps, and research. The flagship; one env var away (CODEX_MODEL) on Plus or higher.
models.gpt-6.1-sol: Near-Astra performance at a lower cost, for repeated, long-running work. Efforts: low, medium, high, xhigh. OpenAI's recommendation on Plus or higher.
models.gpt-6.1-terra: Clear writing, visual understanding and computer use. Needs Codex CLI 0.159.0 or later. Considered and not chosen: newer than Sol, but not aimed at code review or argument.
models.gpt-6-luna: Focused, high-volume tasks. The default for both skills, at medium: the only model Codex offers on ChatGPT Free.

notes.text: ChatGPT Free: only gpt-6-luna is offered in Codex (verified 2026-11-12). gpt-6.1-sol, gpt-6.1-terra and gpt-6-astra fail there with model_not_found ("not supported when using Codex with a ChatGPT account"), and the /model picker shows only GPT-6 Luna (medium).
notes.source: Codex CLI 0.167.1 on a ChatGPT Free account

notes.text: Plus or higher: gpt-6.1-sol is recommended by OpenAI's docs; the flagship is gpt-6-astra. Not verified on this account.

OpenAI: on Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Edu plans, choose GPT-6.1 Sol (gpt-6.1-sol) when available. GPT-6.1 Terra reached Codex on those plans on 2026-10-26. gpt-5.5 was retired from Codex with ChatGPT sign-in on 2026-10-14; the 5.4 line and older are retired too. Debate's previous default, the 5.6 Sol id, is no longer listed.

Claude Opus 5.5 is inside Claude Pro's limits (Claude Fable 5.1 is not; it bills as usage credits there). The GPT arm runs on ChatGPT Free with the default model; the Plus-tier models need a paid ChatGPT plan.
notes.source: vendor plan pages, carried over from SKILL.md

notes.text: The Claude Opus 5.5 system card's FrontierCode Main score is 54.6% at medium and 54.4% at max: flat. The Claude Opus 5 card explains the shape: at higher effort the model makes more changes than the task asks for. One effort sweep on a code-review benchmark (CodeRabbit, Claude Opus 5) found xhigh more precise but lower recall.
notes.source: Anthropic system cards, CodeRabbit sweep, carried over from SKILL.md

notes.topic: Plus-tier models: Sol vs the flagship
notes.text: Applies on Plus or higher, not to the default. OpenAI puts GPT-6.1 Sol within a point of GPT-6 Astra on agentic coding at one-fifth the per-token price, and Artificial Analysis found no cheaper model at its level at any effort setting. OpenAI also notes Astra at low can beat Sol at high.
notes.source: OpenAI model notes, Artificial Analysis, carried over from SKILL.md

notes.text: Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Fable 5.1 take a per-message effort change without invalidating the cached prefix.
notes.source: Anthropic docs, carried over from SKILL.md

notes.text: GLM-5.2 via Zen stalled repeatedly: one low-effort run on a 591-byte packet ran 44 minutes and never returned; one max-effort run on a 75KB packet returned empty after about 10 minutes. Kimi K3 returned in under three minutes on the same packet. Two observations, not a benchmark.
